sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical Ability Power by XL.
Recovers 5 Cost.
Ability Power scales with the number of Lance type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of 3XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 10).

[Activation]
When a physical attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
L
Activation rate scales with the number of Lance type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 10).
